remaining_presence: Explicit written-accent and contrasting-dynamics function: marked grouping case has one mf mark, no explicit accents or dynamic contrast.
Performed accents remain unvalidated by synthetic playback.
Boundaries outside existing model cuts and competing segmentations.
Direct dotted/tuplet and changing-meter grouping judgments.
Same pitches with changed timing; extension/truncation; displacement/scaling relationships.
Single contrasting A-B and same-register dialogue.
coverage.summary: 12 pilot judgments across five dimensions, four per artist. Limited initial coverage, not comprehensive validation.

limitations: Synthetic notation playback cannot independently validate transcription, recorded timing, performed accents or acoustic sustain.
Relationship retrieval strata use attacked-note patterns, not carry-in equivalence or complete phrase identity.

The marked grouping example has one mf mark at +0q and no explicit written accents or dynamic contrast. Explicit-accent and contrasting-dynamics function remain uncovered; performed accents are not validated.
Silence Ki context includes four unknown-pitch members outside the target; source-pitch mode omits these members. Neutral rhythm can retain their attacks.
One item per source song ID; alternate versions may still represent the same composition.
Only completed captured riff hypotheses enter the frame; failed/unresolved analyses and outside-riff material are unassessed.
Captured riff context may not include four bars before/after.
Pilot samples 12 specified subtypes; broader 60-item coverage and fresh-song checks remain pending.
sampling: Fixed stratified slots, seeded SHA256 ranking across the complete deduplicated source-span frame; first feasible distinct song for each slot. This is development coverage, not a population estimate.

source_snapshot.method: First deterministic coverage-directed draw, LCG tie breaks; hard artist caps and distinct genuine song IDs. Not uniform random.
